messages:
Jess (support): customer FinWave asked this morning for a commercial SLA: 99.99% monthly uptime and p95 <= 200ms for their critical endpoints. asked for premium support (24/7) and SOC2+audit logs. can product confirm feasibility?
Sam (product): hey — thanks for flagging. key questions: is this for Hosted or Dedicated? also what's expected cutover window?
Jess (support): they want hosted initially but will move to dedicated in 6mo. target go-live: end of Q3. they called it 'payments-prod' traffic, steady 200 qps, burst to 1k qps.
Kyle (sales): adding context: FinWave is pushing for contract signature if we can hit 99.99 and p95 200ms. budget approved for Dedicated next year but they want a hosted SLA for first 6 months.
Sam (product): copying basic constraints: hosted SLA for 99.99 is aggressive. we currently offer best-effort hosted SLOs, reserved commits for Dedicated. will need escape clauses (fallback to 99.9) or negotiated penalties.
Maria (eng-sre): technical check: p95 200ms across what model sizes? generation endpoints vary a lot. For embeddings/short prompts likely ok with batching optimizations; for long chat generating >512 tokens, not realistic. need to pin model versions and max response size. also need KV cache affinity and routing to low-latency region.
Sam (product): agreed. propose we scope: 1) list of covered endpoints (token-limited), 2) model family + max prompt/response length, 3) traffic profile (qps and burst), 4) support hours and escalation path.
Jess (support): they want ALL inference endpoints covered (chat + rerank + embedding). can we ask to narrow?
Kyle (sales): FinWave will accept a narrower initial scope if we give an upgrade path. they want contract language that permits us to change covered endpoints with 30d notice during pilot.
Sam (product): OK. I'm drafting a strawman acceptance criteria. sharing here for quick feedback:

```json
{
  "customer": "FinWave",
  "scope": ["chat (<=512 tokens)", "embedding (<=128 tokens)", "rerank (single-doc)"] ,
  "sla_uptime": "99.99%",
  "p95_latency_ms": "200",
  "support_tier": "Premium (24/7 escalation)",
  "deployment": "Hosted primary, Dedicated migration 6mo",
  "penalties": "credit-only; upper cap 3% ARR",
  "rollout_criteria": ["performance smoke test < 2w", "canary at 1% traffic for 48h", "ops runbook and on-call roster confirmed"]
}
```

Sam (product): would add 'observable acceptance' item: token-level cost breakdown and per-route p95 dashboard must be green for 7 days.
Maria (eng-sre): operational notes: to meet p95=200ms we need at least: reserved hot pool for their routes, prefix caching for repeated prompts, and cross-region fallback disabled for first pass. Also require customer to allow connection pinning to reduce cold-starts.
Jess (support): can you produce an ops checklist we can attach to the intake ticket?
Maria (eng-sre): will do. rough items: 
- capacity sizing (GPUs)
- model pinning config
- batch sizing defaults
- KV cache policy
- alert thresholds + runbook links
- cost estimation delta (hosted -> dedicated)

Kyle (sales): timeline constraints: legal needs SLA text by next Tue. can product + eng produce a version we can hand to legal by EOD Mon?
Sam (product): I can produce a first-pass doc today, Maria will fill tech appendix by Mon morning.
Maria (eng-sre): putting TODOs in ops doc. note: we may need a small dedicated pool for warm standby in hosted env — that's an OPEX impact.
OpsBot: created ticket FINWAVE-INTAKE-4827 and linked to product backlog (priority: high). :white_check_mark:
Jess (support): tagging @Sam for the backlog item — please convert to RFC if we need cross-org signoff.
Sam (product): will create RFC and linkage. next steps I propose: 1) refine scope with FinWave (narrow endpoints), 2) produce draft SLA language + rollback caps, 3) eng to produce ops appendix and cost delta, 4) legal review.
Kyle (sales): I'll get FinWave to confirm narrow scope proposal today.
Jess (support): recording acceptance criteria here so CS can onboard once green: (a) 7-day p95 baseline, (b) test canary pass, (c) runbook + on-call assigned.
Sam (product): thanks. I'll update the backlog ticket with the strawman and link the RFC. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to the plan.
Kyle (sales): :thumbsup:
Maria (eng-sre): :thumbsup: will add technical caveats to ops appendix.
Jess (support): :eyes: I'll follow up on the scope call notes and paste into FINWAVE-INTAKE-4827.
OpsBot: FINWAVE-INTAKE-4827 status changed to "In review".
Sam (product): closing loop — target to have SLA draft + RFC by Mon EOD. if anything blocks, ping me directly.
